result_summary.title: Analytics Dashboard APAC: Audit log gaps detected
result_summary.description: We have noticed gaps in the audit logs within the Analytics Dashboard in the APAC production region. It is unclear whether this is a display issue within the dashboard itself or a problem with the underlying Query Engine not returning the correct records. We need help determining the source of these missing log entries for our 25 affected users.
